phaseName: Core Apps I: Notes, Calculator, Terminal
goal: Implement three smaller core apps with full behavior and tests: Notes (CRUD persisted), Calculator (arithmetic + keyboard), Terminal (command parser over the shared mock FS).
summary: Phase 4 complete: Notes, Calculator, Terminal apps fully built with tests. Step 1 (Notes): useNotes hook with localStorage persistence (createNote/updateNote/deleteNote, seed with 2 notes, corrupt-JSON fallback), Notes UI with sidebar (search, list, new-note) + editor (title input, body textarea, delete). 6 unit tests. Step 2 (Calculator): engine.ts with safe shunting-yard arithmetic parser (no eval — tokenize/toRPN/evalRPN, operator precedence ×/÷ > +/-, parentheses, decimals, unary minus, division-by-zero→NaN, formatResult, applyPercent), Calculator UI with button grid + full keyboard support (0-9, operators, Enter, Escape, %, Backspace). 19 unit tests. Step 3 (Terminal): parser.ts with executeCommand over shared mockFS (ls with folder/ suffix, cd with validation, cat reads files, echo with > redirect to file, pwd, mkdir, clear, help, whoami, date), parseArgs handles quoted strings, Terminal UI with dark theme, green prompt, command history (ArrowUp/Down), Ctrl+L clear, auto-scroll. 24 unit tests. All apps auto-discovered via AppRegistry glob. Verification: `npx vitest run` → 71 passed; `npm run build` → exit 0 (59 modules).
